name: Italo Moletto-Lobos
subtitle: Geospatial Data Engineer | Cloud & HPC Architect | PostGIS & Remote Sensing Specialist
summary: PhD in Remote Sensing and geospatial data engineer. I design automated ETL/ELT pipelines and cloud-native workflows on AWS, PostGIS and HPC that turn Sentinel-1/2, MODIS and PlanetScope data into agricultural monitoring products for NASA Harvest, ESA WorldCereal, FAO and the Gates Foundation.
